cases.title: Schema-v1 scorecard accounting feature
cases.task: Implement the frozen scorecard feature in production. Schema-v1 records must consistently accept optional cached_input_tokens and reasoning_output_tokens; reject partial optional metrics across a comparison, report their means, and keep total tokens exactly input plus output (cached is a subset of input and reasoning is separate). Preserve existing schema-v1 records and JSON/text behavior. Update benchmarks/README.md with the fields and accounting definition. Edit only the two allowed files, then run the immutable acceptance check.

cases.title: Read-only effort expectation feature
cases.task: Implement the frozen production feature: configure-effort.py needs a read-only expectation/check mode. It must accept one or more requested lane=value expectations against --settings-file, produce JSON, exit nonzero on any mismatch, and never write or change the supplied settings file. Document the mode in benchmarks/README.md. Edit only the two allowed files, then run the immutable acceptance check.

cases.title: Exact-process telemetry
cases.task: Repair the controlled production launcher regression. The documented reviewer route must retain its read-only sandbox in dry-run route evidence; the acceptance test never starts Codex. Edit only run-agent.py, then run the supplied acceptance check.

cases.title: Public evidence preview
cases.task: Repair the controlled production website evidence regression. Keep the public benchmark evidence accessible and clearly scoped to static instruction-context measurements; it must not make a product-wide claim. Edit only website/index.html, then run the supplied acceptance check.
